anomalies.observed: In the CAN BUS / CAN Interface sections, D10 (across CAN0_P/CAN0_N, next to isolated transceiver U11) and D9 (across CAN1_P/CAN1_N, next to U10) are drawn with an optocoupler symbol: two LED triangles on an 'Input' side tied to the two CAN differential lines, and two photodiodes on an 'Output' side tied to GND (3 pins, Input/Output pin groups). This is visually distinct from every other protection array in the same drawing (U4/U23 TPD4E1U06DCKR Ethernet TVS and U25/U26 USBLC6 ESD arrays), which are drawn as diode/CHx boxes with no Input/Output isolation groups.
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table states D9 and D10 are 'CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N' providing 'CAN bus transient/ESD protection', and confirms 'the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice.' A TVS diode array has diodes clamping each line to ground, not an optocoupler LED across the differential pair with a photodiode output.

evidence.quote: D9, D10 — CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N | CAN bus transient/ESD protection | ... the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice.

CAN BUS sheet: U11 (isolated CAN transceiver, CANH/CANL) -> CAN0_P/CAN0_N, with D10 placed across those lines drawn as a 3-pin Input/Output optocoupler (photodiode output to GND); CAN Interface sheet: U10 -> CAN1_P/CAN1_N with D9 drawn identically as an optocoupler.

anomalies.impact: The CAN0/CAN1 differential pairs lose their intended transient/ESD protection, and the optocoupler LED placed directly across CANH-CANL forward-conducts near the recessive differential level (~2 V), clamping the bus and corrupting/breaking CAN communication to the Odrive motor controllers on J2/J13.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the intended design at D9/D10: where the specification requires CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on the CAN0/CAN1 lines, the schematic places optocoupler symbols (Input/Output pin groups with photodiodes to GND) across the differential pairs, removing ESD protection and clamping the CAN bus. Other oddities (USB LTC4412 path, GLOBAL_EN sequencing, CAN LED polarity, PoE jumper, crystal 16 MHz correction) match documented known issues and are not reported.
